dishes.name: Choucroute garnie
dishes.desc: Sauerkraut cooked with smoked pork, sausages and potatoes. Strasbourg's best-known plate, served in its winstubs.

dishes.name: Strasbourg knack
dishes.desc: A short, pink pork sausage poached and served with mustard and bread. A Strasbourg street food staple.

dishes.name: Alsatian foie gras
dishes.desc: Goose liver terrine said to have been perfected in Strasbourg in the 18th century. Served with brioche or gingerbread.

dishes.name: Baeckeoffe
dishes.desc: A slow-baked casserole of marinated meats and potatoes, traditionally cooked at the baker's oven. A winter dish at Strasbourg's winstubs.

dishes.name: Alsatian bretzel
dishes.desc: A soft, salted pretzel, sold plain or with butter or cheese in Strasbourg's bakeries and market stalls.
